query:
SELECT 
                SUM(CASE WHEN is_buy = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as buy_count,
                SUM(CASE WHEN is_buy = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as sell_count,
                COALESCE(SUM(native_amount), 0) as volume
            FROM swap 
            WHERE token_id = $1 
            AND created_at > $2
